referenceFunction.generalComment: The construction of the datasets allows to change key parameters (like mass of the vehicle, mass of the battery, consumption, life times, etc.) in order to cover a wide spectrum of situations . However, it is important to consider that changing one parameter of a vehicle, e.g. its mass, may lead to changes in other parameters, e.g. the consumption. When modifying the default parameters given, attention should be payed to the possible influence which one parameter may have over the other.; UUID: ccf540cf-00de-3291-af51-0fcf52334a10
